Reject later owned index edits rather than overwrite them at checkpoint.
Include the entire reviewed manifest in the source binding so evidence cannot inherit a different scope.
Separate frozen Git author/committer environment from temporary-index environment.
Report nonpassing imported outcomes in compact CLI output without assuming a detail string.
Parse imported JSON from the exact reviewed bytes rather than rereading its path.
Sync newly created journal directories as well as atomic ledger replacements.
